definition: a person who secretly finds out information
description: At a Paris pavement cafe a man in a beige trench coat, straw hat and dark sunglasses sits at a small round table behind a wide-open newspaper with a cup of coffee in front of him. A long black camera lens pushes through a torn hole in the middle of the newspaper and points down the street; he leans out from behind a lamppost to take another photograph, then hides the camera behind the paper again. A waiter in a waistcoat and tie walks up behind him and stands watching over his shoulder.

de.answer: Er versteckt sich hinter einer Zeitung.
de.question: Was macht der Spion?

es.answer: Se está escondiendo detrás de un periódico.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el espía?

fr.answer: Il se cache derrière un journal.
fr.question: Que fait l'espion ?
